title: Senior Systems Engineer II
jobDescription: Are you a Systems Engineer looking for an innovative role? Do you enjoy being part of a team that works with a diverse range of technology? About the Role We are seeking a proactive Enterprise Tooling / DevOps Engineer to drive automation, Infrastructure-as-Code, and observability improvements across enterprise platforms. The role focuses on reducing manual effort through scripting and CI/CD integration while ensuring scalable, secure, and compliant deployments using Terraform. The engineer will strengthen system reliability through robust recovery planning and post-incident improvements. Strong problem-solving and communication skills are essential to collaborate effectively and modernize our tooling ecosystem. Responsibilities: Design and implement automation to reduce manual operational effort. Contribute to CI/CD pipeline improvements and integration with enterprise tooling. Implement and maintain observability standards (monitoring, logging, alerting). Evaluate and adopt AI capabilities responsibly within tooling ecosystem. Ensure automation aligns with governance, security, and compliance standards. Continuously identify areas for operational efficiency through automation. Drive automation and Infrastructure-as-Code to improve scalability and efficiency. Strengthen CI/CD integrations and observability across enterprise platforms. Ensure system reliability through proactive monitoring and recovery planning. Troubleshoot complex issues and implement sustainable solutions. Collaborate cross-functionally while maintaining clear documentation and governance compliance Requirements: • 5+ years of Systems Engineering experience • BS Engineering/Computer Science or equivalent experience required TECHNICAL SKILLS: • Good exposure on Automation, DevOps, Observability, and AI, • Program installation and troubleshooting. • Knowledge of Terraform & CICD • Knowledge of scripts for automation. • Advanced understanding of system and problem management tools. • Knowledge of system recovery procedures. • Strong problem-solving skills. • Good oral and written communication skills. Automation, DevOps, Observability & AI Exposure Terraform & CI/CD Knowledge Implement Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) for scalable and repeatable deployments. Maintain version-controlled configurations for tooling setups. Integrate tooling deployments into CI/CD pipelines. Review and validate Terraform scripts for compliance and security. Reduce configuration drift through automated provisioning. Knowledge of System Recovery Procedures Develop and maintain recovery and rollback procedures. Participate in disaster recovery (DR) planning and testing exercises. Ensure backup configurations are documented and validated. Support high-availability and resilience design within tooling platforms. Lead or support post-incident reviews to strengthen recovery mechanisms Scripting for Automation Develop and maintain scripts (e.g., Python, Bash, Groovy) to automate routine tasks. Ensure scripts are documented, version-controlled, and reusable. Optimize scripts to improve performance and reliability. Identify opportunities to replace manual tasks with automation. Maintain secure coding practices in all automation scripts Work in a Way that Works for You We promote a healthy work-life balance across our organization. title: Web Governance Specialist
jobDescription: Web Governance Specialist Do you have experience in digital publishing workflows? Are you a team player? About Our Team The Website Strategy team is part of Elsevier’s central Marketing Excellence function and is responsible for Elsevier.com — the front door to our business. We shape and guide the digital experience across the site, ensuring our brand, content, and audience journeys clearly communicate Elsevier’s value. Working across content, SEO, governance, and optimisation, we focus on delivering high-quality, consistent experiences that meet user needs and drive measurable impact. Our team plays a key role in helping Elsevier present a clear, trusted, and compelling digital presence to audiences worldwide. About the Role Support the Website Strategy team by ensuring content on Elsevier.com is consistent, high-quality, and aligned with defined standards and audience journeys. This role focuses on monitoring the website, identifying issues, and ensuring pages follow governance rules while supporting clear, structured user pathways. We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Web Governance Specialist who takes initiative to identify issues, maintain content quality, and ensure consistency across the site. The ideal candidate is comfortable working with structured processes, reviewing content in detail, and coordinating with stakeholders to resolve issues and improve the overall user experience. Responsibilities Monitor Elsevier.com to ensure content follows defined journeys, governance standards, templates, and publishing guidelines. Review pages to ensure correct structure, metadata, and alignment with content standards. Identify non-compliant, outdated, or duplicate content and track required actions. Ensure pages are correctly aligned to defined audience journeys and user tasks. Identify gaps, overlaps, or fragmentation in content journeys and pathways. Maintain documentation of content structures and audience pathways. Support content lifecycle activities, including review, update, consolidation, and retirement. Track and follow up on issues with stakeholders to ensure resolution. Escalate recurring or unresolved issues through defined processes. Provide guidance to content contributors on applying website standards and structuring content effectively. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, digital media, or a related discipline (or equivalent experience). Minimum 2+ years of experience working with website content, CMS platforms, or digital publishing workflows. Strong attention to detail and ability to identify issues in content structure and quality. Understanding of digital content, website structure, and user experience principles. Ability to analyse content and identify improvements to navigation and user pathways. Comfortable working with structured processes and applying defined standards. Strong organisational skills and ability to track issues through to resolution. Clear communication skills and ability to work with multiple stakeholders. title: Data Discovery and Enrichment Expert
jobDescription: Data Discovery and Enrichment Expert Are you passionate about research and eager to work in a dynamic, international environment? Do you want to ensure that cutting-edge Generative AI (GEN AI) solutions meet the highest standards of trust, quality, and reliability—advancing science and education globally? About our Team Our team plays a critical role in supporting GEN AI development evaluations for Elsevier’s Academic and Government (A&G) and Scientific, Technical and Medical Journals (STMJ) divisions. We uphold stringent quality standards for delivered content, empowering researchers, institutions, and governments to foster discovery, innovation, and societal benefit. About the Role You will primarily focus on supporting various initiatives to further develop Elsevier’s products and services, within A&G and STMJ. They will be related to assessing the quality of the scientific content, continuously improving the data models by providing structural feedback on the analysed data. Responsibilities Co-design and execute development evaluations for GEN AI products within Elsevier’s Academic and Government (A&G) division. Ensure that the evaluation processes are aligned with our Elsevier Evaluation playbook, global Responsible AI and research integrity principles. Collaborate with data scientists, product managers, and other stakeholders to ensure evaluation criteria align with product goals and Responsible AI principles. Analyze evaluation data to provide actionable insights and recommendations for model improvements. Ensure AI outputs are accurate, explainable, unbiased, and equitable. Communicate evaluation findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Contribute to continuous process improvement and knowledge sharing within the team and broader organization. Mentor junior team members and support cross-functional collaboration. Requirements Master’s degree in Engineering; PhD is a plus. 5+ years of experience in academic research, scientific publishing, or research technology. Experience in conducting evaluations of AI or machine learning models, preferably in academic or research-focused environments. Strong understanding of Responsible AI principles, including fairness, transparency, and accountability. Proficiency with statistical analysis, experimental design, and evaluation metrics. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences. Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities and a growth mindset. Familiarity with research lifecycle and academic publishing processes is a plus. Their commitment to exceeding expectations goes beyond mere delivery. With a profound focus on flexibility and innovation, Operations not only ensures customer satisfaction but also delight customers by consistently surpassing their expectations in ways that are both adaptable and inventive. As a people-led function, we make continuous efforts to enable operations to become a place of great work and a great place to work! Participate in continuous improvement activities; demonstrate understanding of team’s pain points and take action toward improvement. title: Finance SOX Manager
jobDescription: Finance SOX Manager Do you have strong experience in SOX compliance, internal controls, and audit within finance processes? Are you ready to lead control testing, stakeholder engagement, and compliance excellence within Elsevier’s Finance team? About our Team At Elsevier, our team is dedicated to developing professionals with a strong foundation in finance control, auditing, and reporting disciplines. We tackle a variety of routine compliance challenges, empowering our members to apply their knowledge in practical settings while enhancing their problem-solving skills. We foster an environment of continuous learning through mentorship, training resources, and collaborative experiences, ensuring our team stays current with industry practices and regulatory requirements. Together, we strive to create an inclusive workplace where innovative ideas are valued, and every member contributes to driving compliance and excellence within our organization. About the Role The SOX Manager is responsible for ensuring the effectiveness of internal controls in line with corporate objectives and regulatory requirements, including SOX and related standards. This role reviews, develops, implements, and maintains controls across processes, systems, financial statements, journals, and reports; identifies control gaps and drives timely remediation; ensures process documentation is regularly updated; and supports internal and external audit requirements, including management attestation activities. The role also manages a small team, sets priorities to address operational needs, and oversees team performance through objective setting, reviews, and pay recommendations, with decisions guided by policies, resources, and business plans. Responsibilities · Lead the annual SOX testing lifecycle, including planning, coordination, execution, reporting, and close-out of management testing for key financial controls. · Own and maintain the internal controls framework, including RACMs, narratives, and flowcharts, ensuring accurate documentation across significant finance processes. · Ensure comprehensive control coverage across P2P, O2C, R2R, and other relevant finance processes in line with SOX, ICFR, and financial statement assertions. · Conduct walkthroughs for in-scope financial processes to identify key controls, assess risks, and validate assertion coverage such as completeness, accuracy, and existence. · Evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of manual and automated controls to ensure they prevent or detect material misstatements. · Lead deficiency assessment, remediation planning, tracking, and re-testing to ensure timely resolution and effective control performance. · Act as the primary liaison with business stakeholders, management, external auditors, and internal audit teams to support smooth audit coordination and compliance alignment. · Manage SOX testing delivery and a small team, balancing individual responsibilities with oversight, review, stakeholder training, process improvement, transformation readiness, and ITGC collaboration. Requirements · Hold a bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field, or possess a professional accounting and/or auditing qualification. · Bring over 8 years of relevant experience in financial reporting, SOX compliance, internal controls over financial reporting, audit, compliance, or a similar field. · Demonstrate 2–3 years of leadership experience, including managing a small team of 2–4 people and engaging effectively with stakeholders. · Have strong working knowledge of key systems and tools, including advanced Excel, PowerPoint, Hyperion, Oracle, and an understanding of IT general controls. · Communicate effectively in spoken and written English with a high level of clarity and professionalism. · Work effectively within multi-location and global teams across different time zones. · Apply advanced stakeholder management and engagement skills to support collaboration, alignment, and effective delivery. · Demonstrate strong integrity and the ability to speak up, escalate potential control issues promptly, and quickly learn and apply enterprise AI tools to support technical workflows and business objectives. CI/CD & DevOps: GitHub Actions, container lifecycle management, and CI/CD pipeline implementation and maintenance. title: Solution Architect
jobDescription: Architect – Life Sciences Would you like to take ownership of the technology strategy for the future of Life Sciences research? Do you enjoy working alongside cross-functional technical teams to shape best-practice, AI-enabled solutions at scale? About our Team:- Our Technology teams use cutting-edge technologies to build the products and platforms that advance science and health. Within Corporate Markets, the Chemistry Solutions team is responsible for Reaxys, our flagship chemistry research and data platform, alongside the data pipelines, knowledge graphs and AI services that power it. We give researchers powerful digital tools to tackle some of the biggest problems facing the world today. About the Role:- As Architect for the Life sciences Domain, you will own the definition, development and evolution of our Chemistry Solutions technical roadmap, centred on Reaxys. You will work closely with our Lead Architect — who sets the cross-domain architectural direction — to ensure the Chemistry Domain aligns with enterprise standards while meeting the specific needs of chemistry research, data and AI. You will partner with customers, product, engineering and business stakeholders to guide and communicate critical architectural principles, and you will stay at the forefront of emerging technology — from generative AI and large language models to knowledge graphs and cloud-native data platforms — to identify and shape the next generation of chemistry solutions. Responsibilities:- Own the Chemistry Domain architecture: define, document and evolve the technology strategy and roadmap for Reaxys and our wider Chemistry Solutions, aligned to business goals and to enterprise standards working closely with the Lead Architect for Corporate Markets. Partner closely with the Lead Architect and fellow domain architects to provide consultancy, leadership and clear communication, and to champion software engineering and architectural best practice across teams. Drive AI and data innovation: guide the responsible application of generative AI, large language models, machine learning and knowledge-graph technologies to chemistry data, search and discovery use cases. Provide design and architecture governance: review changes, development projects and technical evaluations, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, maintainable and cost-effective. Monitor domain health: track the design and operational health of the Chemistry Domain and write proposals to address risks, technical debt and emerging needs. Research and assess industry and technology advancements to identify opportunities to advance our technical capabilities and create new solutions in the chemistry space. Embed security and compliance: develop robust information-security and data-governance practices so we respond quickly and effectively to enterprise security issues. Lead troubleshooting: lead cross-functional teams to identify, research and coordinate the resources needed to diagnose and resolve complex Chemistry Domain issues. Other duties as assigned. Requirements:- Significant experience in software, network or systems architecture, with a strong grasp of architectural design, patterns and governance. Good working knowledge of more than one programming language. Practical, current experience applying AI/ML technologies — generative AI and large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, natural language processing, information retrieval or data mining — ideally at scale. Solid working knowledge of several of: cloud-native and distributed architectures (AWS, Azure or GCP), microservices and APIs, large-scale data platforms and databases, knowledge graphs and linked data, semantic search, and high-performance or parallel processing. Familiarity with modern data and ML engineering practices such as CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, containerisation and MLOps. Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, including communicating complex technical content to technical and non-technical audiences alike. A track record of contribution to complex technology projects in a global, matrixed environment. A natural ability to engage, influence and build relationships with stakeholders, teams and vendors across the business. A background or genuine interest in chemistry, life sciences or scientific data is highly desirable. jobDescription: IT SOX Control Analyst Do you have experience in IT Audit? Are You a team Player? About Our Team The SOX team plays a pivotal role in ensuring the effectiveness of all IT/finance controls throughout the organization. With a focus on conducting comprehensive audits and monitoring compliance, the team works collaboratively with both internal and external auditors to uphold the highest standards of SOX compliance. Team's commitment to rigorous oversight and continuous improvement helps safeguard the integrity and reliability of our key processes. Coordinate/collaborate with both the external auditor and internal auditors to deliver SOX compliance effectively and efficiently.
